thread:
maria: Heads-up — noticed a dedicated-customer invoice spike linked to the new sampling shim we rolled yesterday. Seems correlated with route-level dynamic sampling being applied before the route enrichment step.

raj: Oof. Can you paste the quick diff where sampling runs?

maria: Sure — the canary path runs sampling in the proxy right after auth.

leo: That means the sampling tag is picked up by downstream aggregators as the canonical routing signal. If enrichment later overrides route attributes, we can attribute tokens to the wrong SKU.

sophie: Is this why some tenants saw >100% token charge on preview? Saw customers ping SRE. /cc @oncall

oncall: Yep, alerts fired. We saw a cluster of invoice-preview mismatches and silent retries. Billing-bot shows duplicate event ingestion for some request ids.

maria: Minimal repro: tenant A sends request -> proxy samples (samples=true, sample_id=abc) -> enrichment service replaces route_id and plan -> tallyer reads sample_id as final and increments A's preview ledger.

raj: So sampling early biases attribution to whatever header the proxy sets. If enrichment canonicalizes later, dedupe keys must include enrichment output. We currently dedupe on (sample_id, request_ts).

leo: Two options: 1) move sampling after enrichment so the sample inherits canonical route attrs, or 2) enrich events with canonical fields before writing to the sample stream and change dedupe key to (canonical_route_id, request_ts, request_id).

sophie: Moving sampling later is safer for billing accuracy but riskier for performance/latency on the proxy path. Some customers rely on very low-latency sampling to reduce upstream load.

maria: Also, early sampling helped us drop payloads earlier (cost win). If we move it later we might spike network/ingest costs.

raj: Could we implement an enrichment-light path in the proxy for sampling only — just materialize route_id and plan without full join? That would keep low-latency but produce canonical keys.

leo: We tried a lightweight join in the past — it added ~3ms p95. That might be acceptable for canaries but not for 99th percentile SLAs on dedicated.

sophie: Another middle-ground: keep early sampling, but write a small enrichment shim that emits a "reconciled_sample" event once enrichment completes; downstream pipeline would prefer reconciled_sample if present. That preserves early drop but fixes attribution when enrichment finishes.

maria: I like reconciled_sample. Implementation notes: produce reconciled_sample with original sample_id and enriched fields, and update dedupe logic to prefer reconciled_sample for final tally. Edge-case: if reconciled never arrives (timeout), fall back to original sample.

raj: Need schema change: add reconciled_sample.topic and a new header reconciled=true. Also add TTL for reconciled events (e.g., 2m). We must ensure aggregator can atomic-swap counts without double-charging when reconciled arrives.

leo: We'll need idempotent replace semantics in the tallyer: store provisional_count keyed by sample_id, then if reconciled comes, subtract provisional from old-route and add to new-route. That requires write-order guarantees or a compensating transaction.

sophie: Compensations are fine as long as invoices show adjustments and we surface them in the console. Ops needs transparency.

billing-bot: NOTE: If reconciled events are delayed >24h, they may be outside downstream billing windows and lead to invoice adjustments. Recommend reconciled TTL <= 2 hours for stable accounting.

maria: Action items: 1) Raj + Leo prototype reconciled_sample shim, perf numbers (due EOD tomorrow). 2) Change tallyer dedupe logic proposal PR (maria will draft). 3) Console: show provisional vs reconciled token counts on invoice preview (sophie to spec).

raj: I'll spike the shim today. If perf hit is >5ms p95 we revert.

leo: I'll draft the tallyer idempotency model and test harness for race scenarios.

sophie: I'll add a console card for "provisional adjustments" and a tooltip explaining reconciled flow. Also we need a rollback plan for the canary if we see unexpected charge noise.

maria: Thanks team. Keeping early sampling was a nice unit-cost win but accuracy trumps small savings for dedicated billing. We'll aim for reconciled_sample with strict TTL and console visibility.

raj: fyi I'll post a short note in #customer-success once we have ETA so they can proactively message any impacted tenants.

oncall: Logging: enable debug sample tracing for one hour during rollout so we can verify reconciliations are arriving. Use flag sampling.reconcile.debug=true.

maria: Good call. I'll open the rollout ticket with the debug flag and link the PRs. :thumbsup:

sophie: Thanks — nice trade-off exploration. :sparkles:
